description: QAAI as a macOS desktop app

scripts.//typecheck: This workspace is plain CommonJS with no build step, so there is no tsc to run. It still needs a `typecheck` script: `npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present` SKIPS a workspace that has none, which is why this app was outside the repo's typecheck the whole time — 'all 10 workspaces are clean' was really 9. `node --check` is the strongest check that honestly applies: it parses main.cjs, so a syntax error is caught in CI rather than by the first person to launch the app. What it cannot see (does `@qaai/demo` still have a `dev` script?) is covered by check:wiring's desktop-services check.
